trustedEntity.description: The name of the entity that verified the attribute.

verificationType.description:
Indicates the type of the entity that verified this piece of data. It can be:
* `1` verified by a financial institution.
* `2` verified by user input.
* `3` verified by the Trustly internal database.
* `4` verified by an external provider.

verifiedAt.description: Unix Timestamp in milliseconds (since the epoch) when the verification took place.

name.description: Which attribute does this entry refer to.

createdAt.description: Unix Timestamp in milliseconds (since the epoch) when the attribute was fetched from an external source and associated with the user.

link.description: Link to user attribute using JSON pointer syntax.

AttributeVerificationDetail.description: Attribute details as part of a Trustly ID user verification details
AttributeVerificationDetail.title: AttributeVerificationDetail

AttributeVerificationDetailName.description: Which attribute does this entry refer to.
AttributeVerificationDetailName.title: AttributeVerificationDetailName

name.description: The name of the entity where the attribute value was fetched from.

type.description:
Indicates the type of the entity that provided this piece of data. It can be:
* `1` the data came from a financial institution.
* `2` the data came from the user.
* `4` the data came from an external provider.
* `5` the data came from the merchant.

AttributeVerificationMethod.description:
Indicates which type of verification was performed. It can be:
* `1` means electronic identity verification.
* `2` meaning it is manual document verification.
* `3` meaning it is OCR verification.
* `4` meaning it is Trusted Entity.
AttributeVerificationMethod.title: AttributeVerificationMethod

AttributeVerificationResult.description:
Indicates the result of the individual attribute verification. It can be:
* `1` meaning the attribute did not match the expected value.
* `2` meaning the result was inconclusive.
* `3` meaning attribute did match the expected attribute.
AttributeVerificationResult.title: AttributeVerificationResult

ScreeningResultScreeningType.description:
Type of screening being performed. May be:
* `1`: Watchlist Screening.
* `2`: Adverse Media Screening.
* `3`: PEP Screening.
ScreeningResultScreeningType.title: ScreeningResultScreeningType

UserVerificationErrorCode.description:
An error code indicating why the user verification has failed. May be:
* `-1`: no error. the verification was successful.
* `1`: there was an internal, unspecified error (should not happen).
* `2`: the user is below the minimum age.
* `3`: some of the attributes did not meet the minimum verification criteria.
* `4`: some mandatory attributes are not available.
* `5`: the user was identified as a person who is deceased.
* `6`: entries were matched during the screening process
UserVerificationErrorCode.title: UserVerificationErrorCode

reason.description: Descriptive text, in English, on why the user verification failed.

UserVerificationReason.description: An object describing why an user verification has succeeded or failed.
UserVerificationReason.title: UserVerificationReason

UserVerificationResultCode.description:
A code indicating the final outcome of the verification. May be:
* `1`: the verification was rejected.
* `2`: the verification was inconclusive.
* `3`: the verification was approved.
UserVerificationResultCode.title: UserVerificationResultCode
